purpose: Execute one bounded Working Set through a checkpointed, resumable Claude Code Run.
preconditions: A selected Work Item and ready Working Set exist.
Scope, completion criteria, required Evidence, Guards, Decisions, and Pack lock are explicit.
The active Session owns the mutating lease.
steps: start from the adapter-produced execution view
record each material retryable side effect with a stable effect key
checkpoint with exact next action and completed effects
publish a transcript-independent Handoff at the session boundary
resume only after freshness, Pack, Skill, Checkpoint, and lease validation
validate every completion criterion and attach criterion-linked Evidence
complete through the gate and record candidate learning without promotion
prohibitions: do not infer state from an old transcript
do not repeat a completed keyed effect
do not complete with missing or failed required Evidence
do not auto-promote Lessons or Guards
